notice.title: Managing critical third parties
notice.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions must maintain a register of critical third parties, tested exit plans, and annual reviews for outsourced or cloud services supporting important business functions. Compliance is required by March 31, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions that rely on outsourced or cloud services for important business services, and Brivanta Bank is a deposit-taking institution that likely uses third-party technology providers for its digital banking, payment systems, and other operational services.

text:
PRUDENTIAL BANKING BOARD FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Guidance: Managing critical third parties
Notice number: RCN-2026-009
Issued by: Prudential Banking Board
Published: 2026-10-02
Effective date: 2027-03-31
1. Who this applies to
Deposit-taking institutions that rely on outsourced or cloud services for important business services.
2. Background
Firms increasingly depend on a few technology suppliers. The Board expects firms to understand that dependency and to be able to leave a supplier safely.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must keep a register of third parties that support important business services.
3.2 A firm must maintain a tested exit plan for each critical third-party arrangement.
3.3 A firm must review the performance and risk of each critical third party at least once a year.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-03-31.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.text: A firm must keep a register of third parties that support important business services.
obligations.controlDesc: Supplier register completeness check for suppliers supporting important business services
obligations.reason: Policy POL-TPR-01 states "All suppliers are recorded in the supplier register" and Control CTL-151 performs a "Supplier register completeness check for suppliers supporting important business services," which together ensure a register of third parties supporting important business services is maintained.

obligations.text: A firm must maintain a tested exit plan for each critical third-party arrangement.
obligations.controlDesc: Exit plan test for each critical supplier, every two years
obligations.reason: POL-TPR-01 states "Each critical supplier has a documented exit plan that is tested every two years" and CTL-153 provides "Exit plan test for each critical supplier, every two years", which matches the obligation's requirement for a tested exit plan for each critical third-party arrangement.

obligations.text: A firm must review the performance and risk of each critical third party at least once a year.
obligations.controlDesc: Annual performance and risk review of each critical supplier
obligations.reason: Policy POL-TPR-01 states "Suppliers that support important business services are reviewed for performance and risk at least once a year" and Control CTL-152 implements "Annual performance and risk review of each critical supplier", matching the obligation's requirement exactly.
